slice.title: Add supplier selection to products
slice.goal: Connect existing Supplier records to Product create/edit through an optional supplier_id selection, without adding supplier name display or supplier filtering yet.
acceptance_criteria: Existing product create, edit, list, search, category filter, stock quantity, availability filter, Adjust Stock action, availability label, and supplier creation behavior remains working.

At least two supplier records are available as selectable options before the product create/edit browser flow starts. If the current supplier mock storage is empty, extend the existing supplier mock storage with demo supplier records from this scenario.
Product create form includes a supplier selection using existing or seeded supplier records.
Created product payload and API response can include the selected supplier_id.
Product edit form preserves and allows changing the supplier_id assignment.
Browser/e2e for this slice extends the existing product catalog flow and selects already available supplier options; it does not create suppliers as part of the product selection flow.
No supplier filter or supplier name column is required in this slice.
If the baseline supplier mock storage already contains at least two valid Supplier records, preserve it unchanged; do not rewrite it with different field names or demo names.
Any seeded supplier records must match backend/app/models/supplier.py exactly. For the current generated supplier model, records must use contact_email rather than email or phone.

Browser/e2e must select supplier options that are actually present in the rendered product supplier select. Wait for option presence/count, then select by { label: existingSupplierName } or by actual option value; do not pass a label string as if it were a value.
constraints: Use --from-run with a successful products-app-suppliers-resource run as baseline, for example runs/run-009-products-suppliers-resource.
Do not create a second product catalog screen or separate product application.
Preserve supplier management widget and /api/suppliers behavior from the previous slice.
Do not retest supplier creation inside the product selection e2e flow; supplier creation is covered by the previous slice and may be rerun only as regression.
Extend frontend/e2e/products-crud-list-search.spec.js for product supplier selection behavior. Do not invent product_catalog.spec.js or create a duplicate product catalog browser spec for this slice.
Do not add supplier filtering or supplier name display in this slice.
No product delete or supplier delete behavior.
No new dependencies; continue using local JSON mock storage.
Before modifying backend/app/storage/suppliers_json_mock.json, inspect backend/app/models/supplier.py and keep the mock schema compatible with Supplier.
Do not replace existing valid supplier records with records that use different field names such as email or phone.
Do not hardcode supplier option labels in browser/e2e unless those labels are guaranteed by the current mock storage or inserted fallback records.
Use the exact product supplier field anchor data-prototype-id="field.product-supplier-id" consistently in the product form and e2e, unless the approved file plan explicitly selects another anchor.
non_goals: Creating suppliers inside the product supplier selection browser flow.
Supplier name display in product row.
Supplier contracts, scoring, procurement, purchase orders, external integrations, or database migrations.
notes: Second split supplier scenario. Run after products-app-suppliers-resource.
This slice tests product selection from already available supplier options. Do not recreate supplier creation flow inside the product e2e.
This slice is about selecting existing/seeded suppliers, not about changing the supplier schema.
The product e2e must derive or use a supplier label that is actually present in the select; if the selected label is absent, fix the mock data or the e2e setup before selectOption.
Incremental scenario. Use after a successful run of samples/products-app-suppliers-resource.
Ensure supplier mock storage has demo suppliers for the product select before browser/e2e selection checks.
